sample_unit: personalized clinical questions about thyroid disease

links.outcome: Specialist-ranked response quality of RAG chatbot versus non-RAG service LLMs
links.effect: Thyro-GenAI had highest overall response quality inverse-weighted mean rank: 3.0 vs ChatGPT 2.3, Perplexity 2.8, Claude 1.9; reference quality 3.1 vs 2.3, 3.2, 1.8.
links.quote: The overall inverse-weighted mean rankings for Thyro-GenAI, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude were 3.0, 2.3, 2.8, and 1.9, respectively.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the use of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) using clinical textbooks and guidelines compared to baseline general LLMs to reduce hallucinations and improve response safety and reliability.
